claim: If every admissible evaluator is a constant plus a nonnegative combination of proved generators g_j, then Brain noninferiority on every generator implies noninferiority for the whole evaluator class.
proof: For u=c+sum_j alpha_j g_j with alpha_j>=0, expectation gap equals sum_j alpha_j*(E_B[g_j]-E_O[g_j]); if every generator gap is nonnegative the total gap is nonnegative. If one generator gap is negative, choosing that generator falsifies universal noninferiority.

falsifiers: An admissible load-bearing evaluator lies outside the proved generated cone.
